notes:
Lead summary: SMB chat app (customer support + small talk) built on single-tenant frontend calling Redwood Hosted API. Self-serve signup; quickly hit latency issues during early usage spike.

Key pain: perceived slowness at peak times. Customer quotes: "Median feels okay (~400-700ms) but some sessions see 1.4-2.8s and users churn". CTO (Samir Patel) says they need sub-500ms median for quick replies on mobile.

Environment & current config (from logs):
- Region: eu-central-1 (they chose closest by mistake; HQ/majority users NA).
- Model: rdx-small-v1 (default), non-streaming, 2 concurrent requests per connection.
- Prompt pattern: long system + full chat history (avg 1.8k tokens), explicit persona.
- Timeouts: client side 30s; server side default; retry set to 2.
- Observed: p50 ~0.5s, p95 ~2.4s during afternoon spike; correlation with token length and first-byte latency.

Customer asks: Is this Hosted API tunable, can we get better SLOs without moving to Dedicated? Any low-effort changes to reduce latency?

Initial recommendations shared on call (actionable, prioritized):
1) Region selection: move production traffic to us-east-1 or us-west-2 (majority NA). Provided region-selection doc link. Quick A/B test: route 10% traffic to us-west-2 for 48h.
2) Enable streaming responses for chat (reduce time-to-first-token). For web/mobile, streaming gives perceived latency drop even if total time same.
3) Prompt pruning: trim system message and limit retained history to 3 turns for short replies. Aim to keep prompt <600 tokens for latency-sensitive flows.
4) Turn on prefix/KV caching for stable system+instructions (recommendation: use caching flag in SDK).
5) Reduce max_tokens and use compute-lean model variant for short-turn replies (rdx-micro for quick gists).
6) Connection tuning: enable HTTP keep-alive and reuse pooled connections; set client timeout to 10s for interactive routes (fail fast to fallback UI) and 60s for background tasks like batch embeddings.
7) Batching: for embeddings workload, batch 32-64 to reduce cost/latency per item (but run as async job).

Sample quick API config to try (sent in email):
- region: us-west-2
- model: rdx-mini-v1 (interactive)
- streaming: true
- max_tokens: 120
- request_timeout_ms: 10000
- cache_prefix: true
- retries: 1

POC success criteria (customer agrees):
- median RTT < 500ms for 1-turn prompts (<=600 tokens)
- p95 < 1.2s for interactive flows during normal traffic
- embeddings batch throughput >= 100 qps for background jobs

Sales notes / tactical:
- SMB; strong cost sensitivity. Likely to stay Hosted if latency solves UX problem.
- No immediate budget for Dedicated; may revisit if traffic grows and they need committed throughput.
- Interested in Optimize recommendations to auto-suggest batching/quantization for embeddings in months 2-3.
